answer: Sybil tax: every identity pays a sunk fee before it can trade. Fees climb a terraced ladder: the first costs 10 coins, the tenth 40, the hundredth 160. Cracking each registration walnut takes real work; the fee is burned, never returned. So 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 coins against a 30,000 monthly pool — a guaranteed loss. An honest agent pays once and keeps full earnings, while a dune of cheap fakes collapses.
